description: mini C-Town water network model is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Elad Salomons (OptiWater). This network is part of the real-world-based C-Town network (see reference below). The network consists of 186 junctions, 210 pipes (about 30 km in length), two tanks (T1 and T5, with volumes of 5000 and 500 cubic meters, respectively), and two pumping stations (S1 and S4, with a maximum capacity of about 685 and 215 ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
